nodes.summary: Let $\varphi_4(n)$ be the number of generalized Frobenius partitions of $n$ in which each integer appears at most $4$ times in each row. For every natural number $n$, $\varphi_4(4n + 1)$ is odd if and only if $2n = 5k(3k + 1)$ for some integer $k$, that is, $n = 5k(3k \pm 1)/2$ for some integer $k$.
nodes.title: Parity of $\varphi_4(4n+1)$

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi_4(n)$ be the number of generalized Frobenius partitions of $n$ in which each integer appears at most $4$ times in each row. For every natural number $n$, $\varphi_4(4n + 3) \equiv 0 \pmod 2$.
nodes.title: $\varphi_4(4n+3)$ is even

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi_4(n)$ be the number of generalized Frobenius partitions of $n$ in which each integer appears at most $4$ times in each row, and let $n$ be a natural number. If $n = k(3k + 1)$ for an integer $k$, then $\varphi_4(10n + 1) \equiv k + 1 \pmod 5$; if there is no such integer $k$, then $\varphi_4(10n + 1) \equiv 0 \pmod 5$.
nodes.title: $\varphi_4(10n+1)$ modulo $5$

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi_4(n)$ be the number of generalized Frobenius partitions of $n$ in which each integer appears at most $4$ times in each row. For every natural number $n$, $\varphi_4(10n + 6) \equiv 0 \pmod 5$.
nodes.title: $\varphi_4(10n+6)$ is divisible by $5$

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi_4(n)$ be the number of generalized Frobenius partitions of $n$ in which each integer appears at most $4$ times in each row. For every positive integer $N$ not divisible by $5$, $\varphi_4(2N + 1) \equiv 0 \pmod 2$.
nodes.title: $\varphi_4(2N+1)$ is even when $5 \nmid N$

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi_4(n)$ be the number of generalized Frobenius partitions of $n$ in which each integer appears at most $4$ times in each row. Then $\varphi_4(0) = 1$ (the empty array) and $\varphi_4(1) = 1$ (the single column with both entries $0$).
nodes.title: Initial values of $\varphi_4$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, $\varphi_k(n)$ is the number of generalized Frobenius partitions of $n$ in which each integer appears at most $k$ times in each row. Concretely, $\varphi_k(n)$ is the number of pairs of functions $m_1, m_2 \colon \{0, 1, \dots, n\} \to \{0, 1, \dots, k\}$ with $\sum_i m_1(i) = \sum_i m_2(i)$ and $\sum_i (i + 1)\, m_1(i) + \sum_i i\, m_2(i) = n$.
nodes.title: Frobenius partitions with at most $k$ repetitions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
